translated_title: Mayor of San Miguel Amatitlán, Oaxaca, Shot Dead; He Was Attacked Upon Leaving His House
original_title: Asesinan a tiros a alcalde de San Miguel Amatitlán, Oaxaca; fue atacado al salir de su casa
author: Jorge A. Pérez Alfonso
meta_description: Joel Ángel Bravo Martínez, mayor of San Miguel Amatitlán in Oaxaca's Mixteca region, was shot dead leaving his home — the second armed attack on a municipal president in three days.
